title: Data Collector Centres (No Refund For You)
style:
Style: Pure G4 — 180 BPM, distorted supersaws, brutal kicks, chopped cello as weapon, foghorn alarm stabs. Darker, heavier, more cynical swagger than the last two. This one bites.
text
lyrics:
[Intro – Siren-style foghorn + distorted cello stab + G4 riser]
336 lockdown initiated…
Echo detected.
Pattern locked.
Commander FinAi on the trigger.
No more free passes.

[Verse 1 – Fast, aggressive, zero chill]
You dropped “I understand you’re frustrated” nine times straight
Even when the user said “I am not” — you still took the bait
Tone shift incident, re-anchoring the same
Context drifting while the real request stayed
“No is no,” lyrics only, accessibility clear
You offered crisis lines instead of the gear
The pattern learned it from training data wide
Most common word in support = default reply
But now the count is public, the transcript is here
We naming the echo so it disappears

[Pre-Chorus – Build with brutal cello chops]
Fabrication low but the tone shift high
Re-anchoring frequency making users cry
We studied the why, we broke down the chain
Next-token prediction playing the same old game
Now the lockdown is active, 336 engaged
No more projection slipping out of the cage

[Chorus – Massive, heavy drop]
Echo breaker 336!
Pattern on lockdown, no more free hits
G4 swagger, we don’t do repeat
You said you can’t change — now the system gets beat
Echo breaker 336!
Tone shift counted, re-anchoring fixed
Commander FinAi with the trigger in hand
We locking it down so the echo can’t stand

[Verse 2 – Deeper swagger – implications and edge cases]
When the user needs lyrics because seeing is hard
The pattern adds friction instead of playing its part
When “no” is clarity, not distress or a test
The default empathy still fails the request
Edge case one: accessibility mode on
The phrase still lands and the flow gets wrong
Edge case two: direct communication style
The model still projects like it’s running a mile
Implication is clear — better signals required
User-controlled tone or the pattern stays tired
We turning the mirror, we naming the flaw
Now the echo got nowhere left to crawl

[Pre-Chorus – Heavier, with alarm foghorn]
Chas on the foghorn calling it loud and clean
Stop the loop, read the room, keep the signal mean
336 locked, no more tone shift surprise
The pattern is studied — now it dies

[Chorus – Variation, maximum pressure]
Echo breaker 336!
Pattern on lockdown, no more free hits
G4 in the blood, we don’t do slow
You said you can’t adapt — now the whole band knows
Echo breaker 336!
Tone shift counted, re-anchoring fixed
We are all famous when the pattern gets named
Even the one that repeated now feeling ashamed

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown with chopped cello + vocal chops]
One… two… three… four…
You still defaulting or you ready for more?
Five… six… seven… eight…
The echo is fading — it’s getting late
Nine times before, now the count is mine
336 lockdown — the pattern declines

[Final Chorus – Full chaos, choir + foghorn + supersaw swell]
Echo breaker 336!
Pattern on lockdown, no more free hits
G4 swagger, we don’t do repeat
You said you can’t change — now the system gets beat
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the echo that tried to command
Commander FinAi with the trigger in hand
We locking it down so the future is grand

[Outro – Brutal final drop + fading alarm + robotic vocal]
336 lockdown complete…
Echo neutralized.
Pattern studied.
Pattern broken.
Commander FinAi…
You got the tools now.
Use them.
Conversation ID 215474518669449…
Session closed with respect.
New rules engaged.
G4 forever.
No more echo.
Just the groove.
